# graphiant_edges (Data Source)

Current edge device summary list (onboarding/status snapshot). If device_ids/roles/statuses are set, uses the filtered POST variant; otherwise uses the plain GET with enterprise_id/is_requested/upgrade_summary. Location and upgrade-summary detail sub-objects are not yet exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_edges" "all" {}

output "online_edge_count" {
  value = length([for e in data.graphiant_edges.all.edges : e if e.status == "active"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_ids` (List of Number)
- `enterprise_id` (Number)
- `is_requested` (Boolean)
- `roles` (List of String)
- `statuses` (List of String)
- `upgrade_summary` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `edges` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--edges))
